title: openom claim-model record
$comment: One frozen shape for every synced record: an Anchor (pure identity) or a Claim (the universal envelope). Attestations and tombstones ARE Claims, discriminated by `predicate` (there is no targetType). Extension-by-predicate: an unknown predicate is permitted and its `value` is opaque; the two core meta-predicates (attest, tombstone) additionally constrain `value`. camelCase field names match openom-claim's serialization. ids/hashes/signatures are re-derived and checked in Rust (openom-claim), not here. Bump x-openom-bounds-version when a bound widens.

sha256Id.$comment: content-hash id: 'sha256:' + lowercase hex of the 32-byte content hash

didKey.$comment: createdBy: the author's Ed25519 keyring identity as a did:key (base58btc, always z6Mk...)

epochMs.$comment: createdAt in epoch milliseconds; PROVENANCE only, never a tiebreak (design principle 2)

sourceId.$comment: the id of a Source claim (§10.2)

locator.$comment: page/entry/etc.; resolves into the source's media

citations.$comment: inline evidence: one citation, or an array when one assertion is backed by several sources

tombstoneValue.$comment: empty: a tombstone carries no value, only its targetId

signature.$comment: optional (tree-level signed_claims): Ed25519 over the domain-separated content hash by the createdBy key

targetId.$comment: the anchor/claim this asserts about — a uuid, a claim id, or a fingerprint

allOf.$comment: attestation = a claim whose value is a verdict
tombstone = a claim with an empty value
